name: Lisa H. Jamieson
tagline: Top rated Estate Planning & Probate attorney in Fort Worth, Texas
about: Lisa H. Jamieson is an attorney providing legal services covering Estate Planning & Probate, Estate & Trust Litigation and Elder Law.

Lisa Jamieson, who practices law in Fort Worth, Texas, was selected to Super Lawyers for 2003 - 2026. This peer designation is awarded only to a select number of accomplished attorneys in each state. The Super Lawyers selection process takes into account peer recognition, professional achievement in legal practice, and other cogent factors.
Prior to becoming an attorney, she studied at Baylor University School of Law. She graduated in 1984. After passing the bar exam, she was admitted to legal practice in 1984.
